people.name: Michael
people.line: An archangel who fights for God's people.

translations.web: There was war in the sky. Michael and his angels made war on the dragon. The dragon and his angels made war.
translations.bsb: Then a war broke out in heaven: Michael and his angels fought against the dragon, and the dragon and his angels fought back.
translations.kjv: And there was war in heaven: Michael and his angels fought against the dragon; and the dragon fought and his angels,
translations.asv: And there was war in heaven: Michael and his angels going forth to war with the dragon; and the dragon warred and his angels;
